blocks.html:
This method retrieves a reservation by ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Reservation](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#reservations\_getreservationsid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the reservation.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: line_item_id
children.description: The ID of the line item that the reservation is for.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the location that the quantity is reserved from.

children.name: external_id
children.description: The ID of the reservation in an external system.

children.name: inventory_item_id
children.description: The ID of the inventory item that the reservation is for.

children.name: inventory_item
children.description: The inventory item that the reservation is for.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the reservation.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user that created the reservation.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date that the reservation was deleted.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date that the reservation was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date that the reservation was updated.
